assets.prompt: Single isolated textbook object plate for a Year 12 biology practical video: a loose loop of soft white cotton string lying on a tabletop plane, forming a rough circular opening large enough to surround four short pop-bead chains. Entire loop visible, no knots, no labels, no other objects, no hands. Fine dark ink outlines and restrained natural watercolour washes, tactile fibres, subtle cream-grey shading, matching the project existing m5x scientific apparatus plates. Centred on a square transparent canvas with at least 10% clear margin, strong silhouette legible at 200 px. True transparent alpha background, no ground, no cast shadow outside the string.

assets.prompt: Single isolated textbook object plate: one plain white six-sided die with gently rounded corners, seen from slightly above in three-quarter view. The broad TOP face must be COMPLETELY BLANK and unobstructed so software can draw variable pips there later. Two visible SIDE faces show ordinary correctly arranged recessed black pips: one side has exactly two pips at opposite diagonal corners; the other side has exactly three pips on a diagonal. Geometry must read as a real cube. No numbers, letters, logos, arrows, hands or other objects. Fine dark ink outline and restrained cool grey watercolour shading, matching existing m5x scientific apparatus plates. Centred on a square transparent canvas with at least 10% clear margin; legible at 200 px. True transparent alpha background, no tabletop or cast shadow outside object.
